1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: __performed by a processor__, determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, __wherein the method includes at least one additional technological step beyond the abstract idea of authenticating a recipient and making a payment, comprising: automatically verifying that the biometric authentication was performed using a secure authentication protocol requiring specialized hardware or software not available to the general public__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing step, __and wherein the method further comprises automatically cross-referencing biometric authentication records with payment transaction records to establish a temporal nexus between authentication and payment eligibility__.

3. (Previously presented) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

4. (Previously presented) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, __and wherein the method further comprises verifying recipient eligibility status against a government database prior to making the benefit payment__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, __and wherein the method further comprises validating the payment transaction through a secure payment processor that requires multi-factor authentication__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, __and wherein the method further comprises verifying device identification and location data associated with the mobile device__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made via an electronic monetary transfer to an account owned by the recipient, __and wherein the method further comprises encrypting and securely transmitting the payment through a dedicated financial network__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made by sending a check to the recipient, __and wherein the method further comprises generating and tracking the check through a secure printing and delivery system__.

10. (Currently amended) A method comprising: __performed by a processor__, determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing, at a first point in time, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; determining that the data store contains an indication that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication most recently with respect to one of said payment transactions at a second point in time earlier than the first point in time; comparing a time interval defined by the second and first points in time with a pre-determined permissive time interval; making the benefit payment, without requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time does not exceed the pre-determined permissive time interval; and requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, prior to making the benefit payment, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time exceeds the pre-determined permissive time interval, __wherein the method includes at least one additional technological step beyond the abstract idea of authenticating a recipient and making a payment, comprising: automatically verifying biometric authentication records against a secure authentication protocol database and cross-referencing temporal data with payment transaction records to establish eligibility__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is seven days, __and wherein the method further comprises automatically flagging recipients whose biometric authentication records exceed the permissive time interval for additional verification__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is 24 hours, __and wherein the method further comprises automatically escalating the authentication requirement when the time interval exceeds 24 hours__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, __and wherein the method further comprises verifying recipient eligibility status against a government database and cross-referencing with biometric authentication records__.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus comprising: a processor; and a memory in communication with the processor, the memory storing program instructions, the processor operative with the program instructions to perform functions as follows: determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, __wherein the processor is further operative to automatically verify that the biometric authentication was performed using a secure authentication protocol requiring specialized hardware or software not available to the general public, and to cross-reference biometric authentication records with payment transaction records to establish a temporal nexus between authentication and payment eligibility__.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing, __and wherein the processor is further operative to automatically cross-reference biometric authentication records with payment transaction records to establish temporal eligibility__.

16. (Previously presented) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

17. (Previously presented) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

18. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, __and wherein the processor is further operative to verify recipient eligibility status against a government database prior to making the benefit payment__.

19. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, __and wherein the processor is further operative to validate the payment transaction through a secure payment processor that requires multi-factor authentication__.

20. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 19, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, __and wherein the processor is further operative to verify device identification and location data associated with the mobile device__.
